name: oh-my-unified
description: Unified OpenCode plugin combining oh-my-openagent + oh-my-opencode-slim with PersistentTaskEngine, MCP Bus, and Assessment→Assembly→Action workflow

scripts.build:plugin: bun build src/index.ts src/tui.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @ast-grep/napi --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external jsdom --external zod --external react --external ink --external better-sqlite3
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --format esm --external @ast-grep/napi --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external @opencode-ai/sdk --external jsdom --external zod --external better-sqlite3
scripts.build: bun run build:plugin && bun run build:cli
